items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Luke Elton, I had the opportunity to go there a couple of times.

ctx.x: And see, the average musician there, he goes out for what they got to do. He don't go out for big time. See, when I started, I was going out for the biggest band in the city. Maybe go to New York. Luke Elton, I had the opportunity to go there a couple of times. See, but I was making much money here that they were making in New York. And I had my family.
What was the first band you stayed with?
